pay_detail: The fair itself is free. Employers there hire for paid jobs.
name: Naperville Community Job Fair
what_you_do: Meet hiring managers face to face. Past fairs also offered resume reviews, mock interviews and money basics. There was also a high school panel on career paths in Illinois.
who_can_apply: Job seekers from high school students (ages 15 and up) to older adults. Free.
deadline_text: Saturday, January 2, 2027, 10:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m., Fort Hill Activity Center, 20 Fort Hill Drive, Naperville.
how_to_apply: Walk in. KidsMatter says no registration is necessary. You can try a mock interview, work on a resume and talk about financial literacy there. Questions: sherilyn@kidsmatter2us.org or 630-864-3960.
notes: The Park District says students can use the January fair to plan summer jobs. KidsMatter's 2027 page lists mock interviews, resume help and money skills. Last year's fair also had panels on the 7 Illinois career paths. Confirm what is offered in 2027. A news post from March 2025 also described a spring job fair for summer jobs. Illinois: the Evanston Township High School work permit page says workers under 16 need a work permit (employment certificate) before starting.
